**<input>**

_HTML element_

```typescript
const element: HTMLElementTagNameMap["input"]
```

Provides a form control whose behavior depends on its type.

**Editor behavior**
- Go-to-definition uses TypeScript DOM lib data when the type service is available.
- Component resolution is skipped for this tag because it is part of the platform DOM surface.

**Example**

```vue
<template>
  <input>
</template>
```

**HTML syntax**

Void elements do not have child content or an end tag.

**Docs**

[MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input)

[HTML Living Standard](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-input-element)

**id on <input>**

_HTML attribute_

```typescript
id: HTMLElementTagNameMap["input"]["id"]
```

Native DOM attribute recognized by the Vue template compiler. Vue patches it on the platform element rather than resolving it as a component prop.

**Runtime surface**

DOM reflected attribute

**Editor behavior**
- Hover and go-to-definition use the DOM library type for the reflected property when the type service is available.
- Component prop lookup is skipped because the enclosing tag is a native element.

**Example**

```vue
<template>
  <input id="...">
</template>
```

**Docs**

[MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Global_attributes/id)
